description: Your own Barmaan projects that the team has published to you: code, title, status (planned, active, on_hold, completed, cancelled), type, real progress (from milestones or team-recorded; null when none recorded), dates, overdue flag and next milestone. Includes summary counts (KPIs) and facets. Filter by q (title/code), status, type; sort by updated, due or title; page with page and page_size. Empty means no project is linked to your account yet. Free text is wrapped as data.

q.description: Search in title, summary and project code.

name: projects_list
